reason: As someone who has quit three of these before, B answers what I actually worry about: no contract, skip or cancel any time, meal swaps, a call with the dietitian first, and an upfront admission that 14 self-selected people with untracked medication changes is weak evidence. A is honest too but vaguer, adds unsupported claims like "less than most takeout" and "protein and fiber," and leaves me unsure what I'm locked into.
